escena: SCENE (staged, cinematic high-impact editorial photograph, a real small modern apartment kitchen at night, dark): Isabella, wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE, sits casually at the far RIGHT end of the kitchen counter, framed from the waist up; her left shoulder is at about 64 % of the frame width and her body stays between 62 % and 80 % of the frame width and a wide band of empty darkness runs between the left edge of the frame and her body; camera about four meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS. A modern smartphone on a tiny tripod stands on the counter at about 84 % of the frame width, at the frame-right of her, recording her; the phone shows us its back and its screen adds no light. THE MOMENT: she laughs mid-sentence and looks down-right into the phone, wide bright smile, completely natural, filming a short home video. Her own live video is PROJECTED huge on the kitchen wall between 82 % and 100 % of the frame width, along the frame-right edge as one tall vertical 9:16 frame of cool white-azure light, much larger than her, as if her small homemade video had become a billboard: it shows her same laughing moment, soft and slightly out of focus, with a fine glowing edge. That projection is the only key light of the scene and lights her side-on. Appliances and shelves stay in deep shadow. Everything lit stays inside the RIGHT 45% of the frame. The LEFT 55% is calm, deep dark, empty kitchen space with no plants, no shelves lit and no objects catching light. No warm light, no tungsten, no logos of any other brand, no readable text.

lecho.objeto: the dark matte kitchen counter edge close to the lens, outside every light

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark space on the left 45% of the frame

llave.fuente: the huge vertical projection of her own video on the kitchen wall along the frame-right edge
llave.lado: to the frame-right of her face, side-on, at head height

fondo: the dark kitchen shelves far behind, with two or three cold small bokeh points
